description:
Use this when the user wants the timing of part of a clip changed: "slow down the part at 0:12", "freeze on
the reaction for 2 seconds", "cut out 0:20 to 0:25". One change per call; captions follow the footage.
Not for: the whole clip faster or slower (style_clip speed), silences or trimming (edit_clip). Undoable
(undo_edit). Costs no Horizon Units. Returns job_id; job_status waits for it.

end_seconds.description: End of the part, in seconds as it plays. 0 means the clip end. Not used with freeze_seconds.

freeze_seconds.description: Holds the frame at start_seconds for this long, 0.1 to 10 seconds, e.g. 2. Use alone, one change per call.

remove.description: True cuts start_seconds to end_seconds out of the clip. False (default) removes nothing. Use alone, one change per call.

speed.description: Playback speed for the part, 0.25 to 4. 1 is normal, 0.5 is half speed. Use alone, one change per call.

start_seconds.description: Start of the part, in seconds of the clip as it plays (0:12 is 12). For freeze_seconds it is the frame to hold.

name: retime_clip
title: Change timing
